api.base_url: https://{host}:50000/b1s/v1 (OData v3) and /b1s/v2 (OData v4); login POST /b1s/v1/Login
api.openapi_spec_url: UNVERIFIED (per-instance /b1s/v2/$metadata; SAP API Business Hub listing not fetched)

scopes_needed_read: Business One user license/authorizations on the SAP user (no scopes)
auth.token_lifetime: Session cookie B1SESSION, default SessionTimeout 30 minutes idle (configurable in b1s.conf)
auth.refresh: No refresh: re-POST /Login with CompanyDB, UserName, Password when session expires

access_requirements.partner_program_name: SAP PartnerEdge for certification/listing only; calling Service Layer needs none
access_requirements.customer_admin_must_do: Provide an externally reachable Service Layer URL (port 50000 or reverse proxy / VPN / IP allow-list), the CompanyDB name, and a dedicated B1 user with a license (e.g. Indirect Access/Professional) and read authorizations. Hosted customers: ask hosting partner to expose Service Layer.
access_requirements.cost_to_us: None to us; customer needs a Business One user license for the integration user (UNVERIFIED)

sandbox.how_to_get: No public sandbox found; SAP B1 trial/demo through SAP partners, UNVERIFIED

rate_limits: UNVERIFIED; sessions limited by licenses/Service Layer load-balancer instances

unified_api_coverage.apideck: unverified (name 'SAP Business One' not found in connectors page text)

blockers: Customer-hosted on-prem/SQL or HANA: network exposure of port 50000 is the real blocker
Per-session login and 30 min timeout means session management code
Limited public docs verified; no sandbox
sources: https://help.sap.com/doc/fc2f5477516c404c8bf9ad1315a17238/10.0/en-US/Working_with_SAP_Business_One_Service_Layer.pdf (search snippet) - "Service Layer responds to login requests at port 50000 ... B1SESSION ... SessionTimeout value of 30"
